Frequently Asked Questions

What’s included in Parsley’s Complete Care program?

5 medical visits with your dedicated board-certified clinician
2 functional nutrition coaching sessions
Access to advanced diagnostic lab testing
Personalized care plan covering recommendations for: nutrition, exercise, sleep, stress management, and prescription medications, as clinically appropriate
Dedicated RN Care Manager and Care Coordinator
Progress tracking via the Parsley Symptom Index
20% off professional-grade supplements
Parsley Perks: member-exclusive discounts

For members using insurance, eligible medical costs — medical visits, lab testing, and prescription medications — are billed through your plan, reducing out-of-pocket costs. The membership fee is also lower, at $150/month or $1,500 for the year when paid upfront (2 months free). For those who choose the self-pay option, monthly costs are $275/month for 12 months.
